name: Typing SM - Muchiuchi
source:
[url=/v1946]Maid in Heaven[/url], [url=/v8102]SEEK remasters[/url] and [url=/v6028]Gakuen Sodom remasters[/url] are presented as three typing games with increasing difficulty level.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]

[url=/v1946]Maid in Heaven[/url] - training mode covering everything from individual keys to short paragraphs
[url=/v8102]SEEK remasters[/url] - mostly focused on typing words and short phrases
[url=/v6028]Gakuen Sodom remasters[/url] - type out your choices to proceed with the story
translation:
[url=/v1946]《Maid in Heaven》[/url]、[url=/v8102]《SEEK》重制版[/url]与[url=/v6028]《学园Sodom》重制版[/url]被改编成3款难度逐步提升的打字游戏。

[根据 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vndb-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]修改]

[url=/v1946]《Maid in Heaven》[/url]——训练模式，从单个按键到短段落全面覆盖。
[url=/v8102]《SEEK》重制版[/url]——主要练习输入单词与短语。
[url=/v6028]《学园Sodom》重制版[/url]——输入选项内容，推动故事发展。
